looks.label: Half-lambert shade with one fixed light
looks.technique: shade = 0.5 + 0.5 times saturate(N dot L) with a fixed light direction, times the texture; white fallback texture for untextured parts

looks.label: Portal-room visibility by breadth-first walk
looks.technique: Start cell visible; each portal tested as a bounding sphere (centroid plus farthest vertex); adjacent cell visible on pass; depth cap 8 by default

looks.label: Status tint and icon groups from a 34-bit state word
looks.technique: Three groups: stances, crowd control (stunned, blinded, dizzy, intimidated, immobilized, frozen), damage over time (poisoned, bleeding, diseased, on fire)

looks.label: Floating status text with a category tag
looks.technique: Short text above the object for hit-location feedback or an NPC reaction, with a file and entry pair for localisation

looks.label: Short idle gesture
looks.technique: A short performance gesture message; idle use is our idea, not the donor's

looks.label: Animation-state selection from posture and locomotion
looks.technique: One function maps context to a state name; hard cuts between states; weapon-specific idle is a known gap

looks.label: Pose-sheet capture (idea only)
looks.technique: Fixed-camera stills per pose, rest pose first; name only, not read

originals.name: Portal-room visibility
originals.idea: Dungeon rooms are cells joined by doorway portals; walk doorways breadth-first and show only rooms whose doorway is in view, capped at a small depth
originals.keep: Breadth-first walk; sphere test on the doorway; depth cap
originals.change: Ring-arena rooms with our own doorways; doorway sphere uses our hit radius

originals.name: Three-group status tints
originals.idea: Stance, crowd control and damage over time each get a tint family and an icon family
originals.change: Our palette and icons; crowd control gets a pulsing ring

originals.name: Footprint pad classes
originals.idea: Each placed prop or building declares a footprint class (small, medium, large) that sets the flattened pad under it; a flag turns the pad off for player-built pieces
originals.keep: Three classes and the per-piece flag
originals.change: Our own pad sizes for the 375-wide frame

originals.name: Terrace step
originals.idea: Terrain height snaps to steps given a fraction and a step height
originals.change: Our own step curve for arena tiers

originals.name: Filter-stack zone rules
originals.idea: A zone is an ordered list of rules, each with a filter (height band, noise band, slope, facing), a shape (circle, rectangle, polygon, polyline) and an affector (height, colour, flora, road, river)
originals.change: Our own noise and shape set; zones as data on one runtime

originals.name: Cancellable idle flourish
originals.idea: A short gesture plays when nothing else is happening
originals.keep: The short gesture in the idle loop
originals.change: Cancels on any input and never plays during a live fight

originals.name: Runtime colour variant
originals.idea: One creature with a set of colour variants instead of separate colour templates
originals.keep: A few colour variants per beast
originals.change: A runtime tint on one mesh with our own hue ramp

originals.name: Category floating tag
originals.idea: A short text tag above the target with a category (hit location, NPC reaction)
originals.change: Our own text and colours at 375 wide
